The '''Coruscant Central Court''' were the central court of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were located at the [[Coruscant Central Court (building)|Coruscant Central Court building]] in the [[Administrative Sector]]. Many of the [[Judge/Legends|judges]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist attack]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
